cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: No Trouble at All
cards.instruction: Remain gracious and accommodating while making your growing inconvenience impossible to miss.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I'll carry your book bag to the platform. My shoulder should manage one more staircase.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Let me take it. There are dictionaries in there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. No, keep your hands free for the tickets. I'll change shoulders at the bottom.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've moved our train to platform twelve, across the bridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, lead the way. I'll give each shoulder a staircase and rest my fingers while you find our seats.

mechanism: A grants B freedom from carrying while graciously retaining the bag and making each added physical burden conspicuous.
confusable: Competitive sacrifice would aim to outdo B; D45 instead accommodates the changing journey while displaying growing inconvenience.
comparison: Heavy dictionaries and platform stairs differ from giving up dinner and waiting for a replacement.
seedUse: Use D45-b shoulder changes and platform move, with S01 permission determining whose hands remain free and how help proceeds.
